Plaintiff has sufficiently alleged damages exceeding $75,000, invoking federal diversity jurisdiction under 28 U.S.C. § 1332. Attached exhibits include the executed contract (Ex. A), communications evidencing misuse (Ex. B), and damages analysis (Ex. C).
